title: Sagility Ltd - 544282 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Healthcare BPO beat FY26 guidance on seasonal revenue (6% vs 5.5% guided); FY27 guided to low double-digit cc organic growth and 24-25% EBITDA margin, with AI compression rising to ~2%.

triggers.label: FY27 growth low double-digit cc
triggers.quote: we are confident of growing in the low double -digits in constant currency for FY '27

triggers.label: Q4 ACV $30.7M signed

triggers.label: AI compression 1-1.5% → ~2%
triggers.quote: we are predicting the compression to be more like 2% in FY '27

guidance.quote: we are confident of growing in the low double -digits in constant currency for FY '27
Our guidance for adjusted EBITDA margin is between 24% and 25%
That gave us uplift in quarter four.
